claims.claim: It is a Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 front label shows Konica Minolta logo and bizhub PRO C754e text.
Photo 0 shows a large office copier standing on a concrete floor.
Report describes it as a black and white office copier and shows no color output.

claims.claim: It is a laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Report shows an office copier with trays and panel but does not show laser printing or scanning.
Photo 0 front label reads bizhub PRO C754e.

risks.risk: The machine does not power on.
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering up and displaying a ready screen.

risks.risk: Printing, copying, or scanning functions fail.
risks.proof: Video of a successful print, copy, and scan with physical output.

risks.risk: Page count or meter reading is unknown or high.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the control panel meter or counter reading.

risks.risk: Drums, toner, or other consumables are depleted or near end of life.
risks.proof: Close-up of consumable status screens or physical inspection of cartridges and drums.

risks.risk: Paper trays or feeders do not work.
risks.proof: Video of each paper tray feeding paper successfully.

risks.risk: Error codes exist or service history is poor.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the error log and available service records.
risks.if_unproven: as unknown errors or service history

risks.risk: Power cord or cables are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and power cord.

risks.risk: Plastic wrapping inside the top paper path may obstruct operation.
risks.proof: Video showing the paper path is clear of packing material.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and reaching ready state
Video of a test print, copy, and scan with output
Screenshot of the meter or page count
Close-up of drum and toner status
Video of each paper tray feeding paper
Screenshot of error codes or service history
Photo of included power cord and cables
Video of the paper path clear of plastic wrapping
response.reason: The witness identifies the Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the front label, so the item is identifiable and can be valued at its worst case pending proof of function.
